**Overview:**  
Maju Murni Consulting Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited firm based in Labuan that offers accounting, tax and company secretarial services. The company was incorporated on 2 September 2004 and has a paid‑up share capital of RM 100,000, with five directors and a single shareholder owning 100 % of the equity. Reported revenues are RM 20,213,545; RM 22,024,982; and RM 25,651,015, while equity figures stand at RM 17,315,587; RM 16,443,702; and RM 17,998,992. No legal cases are recorded, and financial details such as net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not provided.
